name: USPS mail and address-change procedures
description: A scoped reference for permanent and temporary forwarding, NCOALink delivery windows, commercial mail receiving agencies and PO Box street addressing. A private mailbox does not change a legal residence or erase a public record.
scope: USPS operational rules needed for household mail planning. No identity collection, legal residence advice or promise that a mailbox is accepted by every bank, utility or government office.
update_policy: Recheck USPS sources quarterly and after a published DMM change.

changelog.change: First edition from current USPS sources. Replaced the plan's incorrect Federal Register reference.

rows.value: Permanent change-of-address records are supplied to licensed companies for updating mailing lists.
rows.limits: This is a mailing-list product, not a public people search.

rows.value: Receive a 48-month change-of-address dataset each week.
rows.limits: The window describes the dataset supplied to licensees. It is not a mail-forwarding period.

rows.value: Receive an 18-month change-of-address dataset each week.
rows.limits: End User Mailers also receive 18 months but only for internal lists, with monthly delivery.

rows.value: For months 19 through 48, the service can flag that a move happened without giving the new address.
rows.limits: The additional window is not a 48-month new-address feed.

rows.value: Complete PS Form 1583 and provide two forms of identification, including one photo ID.
rows.limits: Provide identity documents to the mailbox provider, not to a GLP tool.

rows.value: A CMRA owner, manager or authorized employee may witness the signature. A notary is another permitted route.
rows.limits: Current DMM permits physical presence or real-time audio and video. Provider workflow can still differ.

rows.rule: How to label the private mailbox
rows.value: Use PMB or the alternative # sign with the private mailbox number.
rows.limits: A mailbox remains a mailbox. Do not misrepresent it as a residence or office suite.

rows.rule: What happens when application details change
rows.value: Submit a new PS Form 1583 when required application information changes.
rows.limits: Identification must remain current. The CMRA must keep its registration database current.

rows.rule: Mail after leaving a private mailbox
rows.value: USPS cannot process a change of address from a CMRA to another address.
rows.limits: Arrange remailing with the CMRA. Confirm postage, service charges and the six-month termination process.

rows.value: Participating locations can accept private-carrier packages using the Post Office street address and box number.
rows.limits: Availability and USPS mailing standards apply. Confirm the location offers this service.
rows.instrument: USPS Premium PO Box Street Addressing

rows.value: Temporary forwarding starts at 15 days and can run to 364 days, using an initial period and extension.
rows.limits: Use temporary forwarding only for a genuine temporary move. It is not a permanent-residence substitute.

rows.value: USPS advises allowing at least 7 to 10 business days after approval for the change to take effect.
rows.limits: This operational lead time does not establish privacy or completion of sender updates.

rows.value: The final CMRA rule became effective July 1, 2023.
rows.limits: The current DMM and current PS Form 1583 govern the operational checklist. Do not treat an old proposed rule as current.
